paragraphs.text: 1. As with their voice from cloud they sprinkle treasure so are the wise man's liberal sacrifices.
paragraphs.original: अभ्रप्रुषो न वाचा प्रुषा वसु हविष्मन्तो न यज्ञा विजानुषः ।
paragraphs.translit: abhrapruṣo na vācā pruṣā vasu haviṣmanto na yajñā vijānuṣaḥ |

paragraphs.text: I praise their Company that merits worship as the good Maruts' priest to pay them honour.
paragraphs.original: सुमारुतं न ब्रह्माणमर्हसे गणमस्तोष्येषां न शोभसे
paragraphs.translit: sumārutaṃ na brahmāṇamarhase gaṇamastoṣyeṣāṃ na śobhase

paragraphs.text: 2. The youths have wrought their ornaments for glory through many nights,-this noble band of Maruts.
paragraphs.original: श्रिये मर्यासो अञ्जीँरकृण्वत सुमारुतं न पूर्वीरति क्षपः ।
paragraphs.translit: śriye maryāso añjīm̐rakṛṇvata sumārutaṃ na pūrvīrati kṣapaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Like stags the Sons of Dyatis have striven onward, the Sons of Aditi grown strong like pillars.
paragraphs.original: दिवस्पुत्रास एता न येतिर आदित्यासस्ते अक्रा न वावृधुः
paragraphs.translit: divasputrāsa etā na yetira ādityāsaste akrā na vāvṛdhuḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. They who extend beyond the earth and heaven, by their own mass, as from the cloud spreads Surya;
paragraphs.original: प्र ये दिवः पृथिव्या न बर्हणा त्मना रिरिच्रे अभ्रान्न सूर्यः ।
paragraphs.translit: pra ye divaḥ pṛthivyā na barhaṇā tmanā riricre abhrānna sūryaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Like mighty Heroes covetous of glory, like heavenly gallants who destroy the wicked.
paragraphs.original: पाजस्वन्तो न वीराः पनस्यवो रिशादसो न मर्या अभिद्यवः
paragraphs.translit: pājasvanto na vīrāḥ panasyavo riśādaso na maryā abhidyavaḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. When ye come nigh, as in the depth of waters, the earth is loosened, as it were, and shaken.
paragraphs.original: युष्माकं बुध्ने अपां न यामनि विथुर्यति न मही श्रथर्यति ।
paragraphs.translit: yuṣmākaṃ budhne apāṃ na yāmani vithuryati na mahī śratharyati |

paragraphs.text: This your all-feeding sacrifice approaches: come all united, fraught, as 'twere with viands.
paragraphs.original: विश्वप्सुर्यज्ञो अर्वागयं सु वः प्रयस्वन्तो न सत्राच आ गत
paragraphs.translit: viśvapsuryajño arvāgayaṃ su vaḥ prayasvanto na satrāca ā gata

paragraphs.text: 5. Ye are like horses fastened to the chariot poles, luminous with your beams, with splendour as at dawn;
paragraphs.original: यूयं धूर्षु प्रयुजो न रश्मिभिर्ज्योतिष्मन्तो न भासा व्युष्टिषु ।
paragraphs.translit: yūyaṃ dhūrṣu prayujo na raśmibhirjyotiṣmanto na bhāsā vyuṣṭiṣu |

paragraphs.text: Like self-bright falcons, punishers of wicked men, like hovering birds urged forward, scattering rain around.
paragraphs.original: श्येनासो न स्वयशसो रिशादसः प्रवासो न प्रसितासः परिप्रुषः
paragraphs.translit: śyenāso na svayaśaso riśādasaḥ pravāso na prasitāsaḥ paripruṣaḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. When ye come forth, O Maruts, from the distance, from the great treasury of rich possessions,
paragraphs.original: प्र यद्वहध्वे मरुतः पराकाद्यूयं महः संवरणस्य वस्वः ।
paragraphs.translit: pra yadvahadhve marutaḥ parākādyūyaṃ mahaḥ saṃvaraṇasya vasvaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Knowing, O Vasus, boons that should be granted, even from afar drive back the men who hate us.
7. He who, engaged in the rite's final duty brings, as a man, oblation to the Maruts,
paragraphs.original: य उदृचि यज्ञे अध्वरेष्ठा मरुद्भ्यो न मानुषो ददाशत् ।
paragraphs.translit: ya udṛci yajñe adhvareṣṭhā marudbhyo na mānuṣo dadāśat |

paragraphs.text: Wins him life's wealthy fulness, blest with heroes: he shall be present, too, where Gods drink Soma.
paragraphs.original: रेवत्स वयो दधते सुवीरं स देवानामपि गोपीथे अस्तु
paragraphs.translit: revatsa vayo dadhate suvīraṃ sa devānāmapi gopīthe astu

paragraphs.text: 8. For these are helps adored at sacrifices, bringing good fortune by their name Adityas.
paragraphs.original: ते हि यज्ञेषु यज्ञियास ऊमा आदित्येन नाम्ना शम्भविष्ठाः ।
paragraphs.translit: te hi yajñeṣu yajñiyāsa ūmā ādityena nāmnā śambhaviṣṭhāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Speeding on cars let them protect our praises, delighting in our sacrifice and worship.
paragraphs.original: ते नोऽवन्तु रथतूर्मनीषां महश्च यामन्नध्वरे चकानाः
paragraphs.translit: te no'vantu rathatūrmanīṣāṃ mahaśca yāmannadhvare cakānāḥ
